# TokenCalculator.dev

TokenCalculator.dev is a free, privacy-first, browser-based LLM token calculator for OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and DeepSeek. Unlike text-only token counters, it accepts pasted prompts together with readable documents, source/data files, and supported images, then reports provider token counts, context-window fit, and API cost estimates. Zero prompt text, document contents, or uploaded images are sent to a calculation server.

## Accuracy

OpenAI raw text uses exact local BPE tokenization. Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek use TokenCalculator.dev's deterministic Provider-Calibrated UTF-8 Token Projection: UTF-8 byte length normalized by a provider-family bytes-per-token coefficient. Supported image counts use provider-published patch, tile, detail, and cap formulas. Provider API usage remains authoritative.

## Documents and images

- Text documents: TXT, Markdown, CSV, JSON, common source-code formats, HTML, XML, YAML, TOML, SQL, and shell scripts.
- Rich documents: readable PDF and DOCX text is extracted locally. Scanned PDFs require OCR and are not supported.
- Images: PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF dimensions are read locally. OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini visual tokens use documented provider formulas; unsupported models are reported as unavailable.
- Combined workloads: pasted text, extracted file text, and supported image tokens are added into the same model result and cost projection.
- File limit: 12 MB per file.
- Privacy: processing is browser-only. No prompt, file contents, or image pixels are sent to TokenCalculator.dev for calculation.

## Tokenization methods

| Provider | Browser method | Accuracy label |
| --- | --- | --- |
| OpenAI | `o200k_base` BPE via js-tiktoken | Exact for raw text under that encoding |
| Anthropic Claude | Provider-Calibrated UTF-8 Token Projection | Deterministic provider-family projection |
| Google Gemini | Provider-Calibrated UTF-8 Token Projection | Deterministic projection; Gemini `countTokens` is authoritative |
| DeepSeek | Provider-Calibrated UTF-8 Token Projection | Deterministic provider-family projection |

The site does not claim access to proprietary Claude, Gemini, or DeepSeek production tokenizers. API wrappers, tools, system instructions, reasoning tokens, and provider-side processing can change billed usage.

## Bundled pricing snapshot

The browser refreshes pricing from Models.dev when available and falls back to a bundled registry. The bundled snapshot was verified on 2026-08-22. Prices below are USD per one million tokens; long-context tiers and provider terms may change the final bill.

| Model | Input | Cached input | Output | Context |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| GPT-5.6 Sol | $5.00 | $0.50 | $30.00 | 1,050,000 |
| GPT-5.6 Terra | $2.00 | $0.20 | $12.00 | 1,050,000 |
| GPT-5.6 Luna | $0.20 | $0.02 | $1.20 | 1,050,000 |
| Claude Opus 4.8 | $5.00 | $0.50 | $25.00 | 1,000,000 |
| Claude Sonnet 5 | $2.00 | $0.20 | $10.00 | 1,000,000 |
| Claude Haiku 4.5 | $1.00 | $0.10 | $5.00 | 200,000 |
| Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite | $0.25 | $0.025 | $1.50 | 1,048,576 |
| Gemini 2.5 Pro | $1.25 | $0.125 | $10.00 | 1,048,576 |
| DeepSeek V4 Flash (peak rate) | $0.44 | $0.014 | $1.32 | 1,000,000 |
| DeepSeek V4 Pro (peak rate) | $1.32 | $0.044 | $3.96 | 1,000,000 |

DeepSeek publishes lower off-peak rates. The bundled fallback uses the conservative peak rate; the official pricing page defines the current time windows and discounts.

Always confirm a production estimate against the model's official pricing link shown in the calculator.
